text_block_list.text:
One day, having been summoned,
I headed to the Chairwoman's office—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"A proposal! Regarding the next single project,
I'd love to hear your thoughts on it!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes. On rare occasions, record companies reach out to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They said they want to provide music
to a girl currently active in the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Day after day! I've been coordinating
between the student applicants and the other side!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Where to perform it, or whether to release it, is entirely up to each individual or group, though."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, having a special song of your own
fosters both confidence and pride.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we do our utmost
to foster the best connections possible.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And so, this time, Falco raised her hand ☆

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
Trainer <username>.
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We're in dire straits! We actually got a request
from the record company. Sounds like the project has run aground.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
'The Uma Musume have so much potential,
I can't create a song that fully utilizes it……!' they said.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "And so they asked me for advice, but... well, we aren't professionals in that field. I'm at a loss for how to advise them."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And so!
Trainer <username>!
I've heard that you're well-versed in this field lately.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
If it were you, what kind of advice would you give
when producing a new song?
I'd love to hear your thoughts for reference!
choice_data_list: How about letting them experience what it's like to be Falcon?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I see!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And with that, record company staff, look alive!
This is the very track the Umamusume race on!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I want everyone to run with single-minded focus!

text_block_list.name: Record Label Employee A
text_block_list.text: Ah, my legs are sinking into the sand...! To think it would be this tough...!

text_block_list.name: Record Label Employee B
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... *pant*...!
So this is the feeling of refusing to lose...!

The record company staff ran around frantically.
Apparently, they managed to put together the project for the new song without a hitch...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: My initial resolve...?
choice_data_list: It's about having people watch our lives and races.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Understood!
Let us make the preparations!

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text: ...It is a truly wonderful concert, Chairwoman. I had forgotten this sight.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Much appreciated! Hearing you say so
makes it all the more rewarding for me as your host!

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text: "I finally remembered. Our project all started from the inspiration we felt watching that race and live concert long ago."

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text: Instead of focusing on making the debut grand, I'll create a song that brings out the feelings I currently hold for her to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text:
"I'll head back to the office right away and let my subordinates know.
Please look forward to our next proposal."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "...Acknowledged! Ah, and also..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This is Trainer <username>,
who gave me the idea.
Allow me to introduce them.

text_block_list.name: Record Label Executive
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you. I look forward to continuing to work with you.
choice_data_list: Likewise, I sincerely look forward to working with you

text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of the opportunity, I explained the Grand Live to them,
and was able to gain their full support, with them agreeing it was a wonderful project.
